'''Foyvè oil''' was a type of [[Oil/Legends|oil]] that could be used to flambée a [[Geniserian sand monkey]]. Geniserian sand monkey flambéed with foyvè oil was considered a delicacy by some individuals and was difficult to obtain.<ref name="Shadows" /> However, around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'' to around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].</ref> an [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] named [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]] was able to obtain the dish while on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. Rhinann provided the dish to satisfy the epicurean tastes of a [[Unidentified individual (Jax Pavan client 1)|client]] of [[Jax Pavan]], who worked as a private [[Detective/Legends|investigator]].<ref name="Shadows" />

==Behind the scenes==
Foyvè oil was first mentioned in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]].<ref name="Shadows" />
